run_benchmark_server: run a benchmark of the latency of running a single batch with an SGLang server
run_benchmark_internal: run the internal benchmark loop that launches a server and measures latency with HTTP calls
build_server_args: build a ServerArgs object from parsed CLI arguments for configuring the SGLang server
build_bench_args: build a BenchArgs object from parsed CLI arguments for benchmark parameters like batch size and input length
save_results_pydantic: save benchmark results as pydantic models in JSON format to a specified output file
